company_name: Hangzhou Cobetter Filtration Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Cobetter specializes in filtration and purification solutions critical for integrated circuit manufacturing.
summary: Hangzhou Cobetter Filtration Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D and production of advanced filtration and purification solutions tailored for the semiconductor and biopharmaceutical industries. Their product offerings include high-purity chemical packages and various fluid handling components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: Cobetter has production sites in Hangzhou and Taiwan, along with branch offices in major cities including Shanghai and Beijing.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Manufacturing presence to support regional semiconductor needs.
regional_presence.United States: Establishing a presence to serve customers in North America.
